id: 695-賈索·錢·卡維爾一世對卡拉克穆爾的行動

battle.name: 賈索·錢·卡維爾一世對卡拉克穆爾的行動
battle.brief: 公元六九五年，佩滕盆地南緣爆發一場為期一年的戰役，戰爭總表列為蒂卡爾對卡拉克穆爾，冠以「賈索·錢·卡維爾一世」之名。此役結局無文字流傳，只餘碑石與城址可考。卡面的斯巴達長矛屬古典地中海的方陣直刺兵器，從未進入中美洲；瑪雅人決定戰線的，是擲矛器、複合弓與被曆法定死的出征時辰。

kit.name: 斯巴達長矛
kit.history: 兩米長的木槍，槍尾帶銅套。方陣裡它比劍更早決定誰站得住。

countries: 這場戰爭記於公元六九五年。戰爭總表把它單獨立為一條「行動」，起訖同為六九五年，交戰方一欄寫的是蒂卡爾與卡拉克穆爾，題名則冠以「賈索·錢·卡維爾一世」。戰場在瑪雅古典期最核心的佩滕盆地南緣：蒂卡爾立於今瓜地馬拉佩滕省北部的高地，居高俯瞰盆地；卡拉克穆爾在今墨西哥坎佩切州，瑪雅語舊名 Kaanul，意思是「蛇之地」，其君主被碑銘稱為蛇王朝，開國一代以 Te' K'ab Chaak 一系為名，其後是西雅赫·錢·卡維爾一世與雅辛·錢·卡維爾二世。同一時刻，佩滕的聯盟版圖正在重排：多斯皮拉斯自六二九年背叛蒂卡爾另立，倚靠北方的卡拉科爾；被壓迫的城邦大批改換盟主。戰爭總表在同一張表裏也收了六二七年起的一整串卡拉科爾—納蘭霍戰爭，以及七三六年、七四四年兩條以「錢·卡維爾」王名為題的征服條目。盆地之外的貝里斯—洪都拉斯一線，卡拉科爾與納蘭霍互毀的戰爭亦進入尾聲，而納蘭霍的君主恰恰也是「錢·卡維爾」的持有者。要留意的是，瑪雅王的王名元素在不同城邦反覆使用，戰爭總表又習慣以王名代替城邦，於是蒂卡爾、卡拉克穆爾、納蘭霍三家的同名前號很容易混成一格。本卡的交戰方按總表所列填蒂卡爾與卡拉克穆爾，同時把北線的納蘭霍—卡拉科爾戰線交代清楚，讓讀者分得清兩條線各自有各自的因果。
countriesEn: This war is recorded for the year AD 695. The war list enters it as a single campaign whose start and end are both 695, with Tikal and Calakmul named as the belligerents, while the title itself is given in the name of Jasaw Chan K'awiil I. The battlefield lay on the southern rim of the Peten basin, the core of the Classic Maya world: Tikal stood on the high ground of what is now the Peten Department of Guatemala, looking down over the basin, while Calakmul lay in the present state of Campeche in Mexico; its old Maya name, Kaanul, means 'Place of the Serpent', and its rulers are called the Snake dynasty, founded by the line of Te' K'ab Chaak and continued by Siyaj Chan K'awiil I and his son Yaxun Chan K'awiil II. At the same moment the alliance map of the basin was being reshuffled: Dos Pilas had broken away from Tikal in 629 and made itself a client of Caracol in the north, and the oppressed city-states were switching masters in bulk. The same table also collects the whole run of Caracol-Naranjo wars from 627 onward, together with two conquest entries in 736 and 744 filed under the name of a Chan K'awiil ruler. On the outer line, in the Belize-Honduras region, the mutual destruction of Caracol and Naranjo was also entering its last phase, and the ruler of Naranjo was himself a bearer of the name element 'Chan K'awiil'. One caution is needed: Maya royal name elements were reused from city-state to city-state, and the war list habitually files a campaign under a ruler's name rather than under a city, so the like-named rulers of Tikal, Calakmul and Naranjo easily collapse into a single line of the table. This card therefore follows the list and names Tikal and Calakmul as the belligerents, while at the same time setting out the northern Naranjo-Caracol front, so that the reader can tell the two lines of war apart and the separate causes behind each.
people: 名號上最關鍵的人物是「賈索·錢·卡維爾一世」。碑銘學界把這個王名繫於納蘭霍伊察姆坎王朝的君主（約公元七〇〇至七二九年在位）：他出身於佩滕南部的一個小邦，靠連續的星戰把納蘭霍拉成強權，並在後來把北方城邦卡拉科爾的君主生擒帶回。而戰爭總表卻把這個名字安在公元六九五年、對手是卡拉克穆爾的一場行動上，交戰方又寫成蒂卡爾與卡拉克穆爾。名號混淆的來源可以查證：蒂卡爾王系有西雅赫·錢·卡維爾一世，卡拉克穆爾蛇王朝有西雅赫·錢·卡維爾一世，納蘭霍有賈索·錢·卡維爾一世，三者的王名骨幹都是「錢·卡維爾」；連總表在七三六年、七四四年兩條征服條目裏，也把交戰的一方記在「錢·卡維爾」的名號之下。除此之外，本役還有幾位可考的人物：蒂卡爾一方的豹葉（Yax Nuun Ahiin I，綽號「葉片美洲虎」，約六八二至七三四年在位），正是他在六九○年代替蒂卡爾擋住卡拉克穆爾的南進；蛇王朝的西雅赫·錢·卡維爾一世與其子雅辛·錢·卡維爾二世；以及多斯皮拉斯的君主努恩·烏卓爾·查克，他六二九年奪蒂卡爾王位後投向卡拉科爾陣營，總表在六七七至六七九年間另有一條「對努恩·烏卓爾·查克之戰」，記的正是蛇王朝對這位附庸的清算。再往下是一批不留姓名的角色：按金星曆定出出征日的祭司、抄寫戰果並刻碑的書記、率領佩槍突擊的貴族隊長、負責俘虜贖金的中人，以及隨軍負重的勞役隊。
peopleEn: The key figure by name is 'Jasaw Chan K'awiil I'. Epigraphic scholarship attaches this royal name to the ruler of the Itzamkan dynasty of Naranjo (reigned about AD 700 to 729): he came from a small polity in southern Peten, built Naranjo into a power through a run of star wars, and in due course carried off the ruler of the northern city of Caracol alive. The war list, however, attaches this name to a campaign of AD 695 against Calakmul, and enters Tikal and Calakmul as the belligerents. The source of the confusion is checkable: the royal line of Tikal had a Siyaj Chan K'awiil I, the Snake dynasty of Calakmul had a Siyaj Chan K'awiil I, and Naranjo had a Jasaw Chan K'awiil I, all three sharing the skeletal name 'Chan K'awiil'; the same table even files one of the parties in its conquest entries of 736 and 744 under a Chan K'awiil name. Beyond the naming, several figures in this campaign can be documented: on the Tikal side, Foliated Jaguar (Yax Nuun Ahiin I, r. about 682 to 734), the ruler who in the 690s held Calakmul's southern advance off Tikal; on the Snake side, Siyaj Chan K'awiil I and his son Yaxun Chan K'awiil II; and Nuun Ujool Chaak of Dos Pilas, who seized the Tikal throne in 629 and threw in his lot with Caracol, against whom the war list has a separate entry, a 'War against Nuun Ujol Chaak' dated 677 to 679, recording the Snake dynasty's reckoning with that client. Below them lies a host of people the monuments do not name: the priests who fixed the day of departure from the Venus calendar, the scribes who wrote up the results and cut the stelae, the noble captains who led the spear thrusts, the middlemen who handled the ransom of captives, and the labour gangs who carried the baggage.
kits: 卡面這件斯巴達長矛是希臘的 dory：兩米長的木槍，槍尾帶銅套，是公元前八百年已定型的兵裝，設計前提是重裝步兵互相遮蔽、以盾牆把長矛頂到敵方前線。公元六九五年的佩滕盆地沒有銅，也沒有歐亞的冶金供應鏈，更沒有那種以整齊盾牆承擔全部防禦的陣式；瑪雅戰士手上最接近「把力量送到身後」的裝備是燧石矛與擲矛器（atlatl）：木鏃配黑曜石或燧石矛頭，擲程遠過徒手長矛，配上複合弓與投石索，構成遠程投射火力。防護是圓盾與虎豹紋的盾面，棉甲要到後古典期才普遍使用；沒有任何鐵器，也沒有可信的攻城器械記錄，攻城靠突襲、放火、破門，封路則靠切斷城邦之間的白石堤道（sacbe）。軍隊的糧秣與投射物由城邦按戶供應，勞役隊隨軍負重，這套後勤結構決定了遠征的距離上限，也決定了卡面那件長矛在本役只能作為對照：它代表的是「以整齊同步的正面換取射程」的思路，而瑪雅人把同步交給了另一樣東西——交給曆法。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Greek dory: a wooden spear two metres long with a copper socket at the butt, a type already fixed in form by the eighth century BC. Its design premise is that heavy infantry shelter one another, that a wall of shields pushes the spears forward to the enemy line. The Peten basin of AD 695 had no copper and no Eurasian supply chain of metallurgy, and no order of battle in which a tidy shield wall bore the whole of the defence. The closest thing the Maya warrior carried to 'putting force behind the man' was the flint spear and the atlatl: a wooden dart with an obsidian or flint tip, thrown far beyond the reach of a hand-held spear, used together with the composite bow and the sling to make a missile artillery. Defence was the round shield, often faced with jaguar or other spotted pelt, while padded cotton armour became general only in the Postclassic; there was no iron at all and no reliable record of siege engines, for a Maya siege meant surprise, fire and a forced door, and cutting a city-state off was done by breaking the white limestone causeways (sacbe) that linked them. Grain and missiles were supplied by the city-states household by household, with labour gangs carrying the load; that logistical structure set the ceiling on how far an expedition could march, and it is why the card's spear can only stand in this campaign as a comparison. It stands for the idea of buying reach with a synchronised front, and the Maya gave that synchronisation to something else entirely: to the calendar.
tactics: 瑪雅高地的打法有自己的規矩。遠征之前，祭司按金星曆（五百八十四日循環，約等於八個太陽年）與二百六十日的週期圈定出征日，選在乾季收成之後、下一季播種之前，於是「星戰」（star war）這種有星象背書的戰役才有法定日子；日子定了，各城邦才發出星戰令，聯軍開拔。行軍是縱隊：貴族帶著佩槍與標槍的突擊隊，步兵以投矛器與弓箭散開成線，沒有方陣，也沒有把全隊擠在一起的盾牆；近身時靠短兵與石斧，一對一抓人。勝負的標準往往不是殲滅，而是擄人：抓敵方君主與世族首腦，帶回本城獻祭，或要求贖金，敵方再以重立聖所、改刻碑銘回應「易主」的儀式。攻城多在夜襲或晨襲中進行，燒掉殿宇、打斷堤道、封住取水與糧道；佔領之後則砸毀敵方的儀式性紀念碑（心組、水組、天象柱），另立自己的。整場戰役唯一像樣的秩序就是節奏：同一個日子、同一套儀式、同一條古道，把遠征軍送到對方城下。斯巴達長矛那種「所有人同時頂出」的同步性在這裏並不存在；這裏的同步性來自一張曆表。
tacticsEn: The highland Maya fought by rules of their own. Before an expedition set out, priests fixed the day of departure from the Venus cycle of 584 days, roughly eight solar years, and from the 260-day period, choosing a moment after the dry-season harvest and before the next sowing, so that a war backed by the stars, a 'star war', had a lawful date; only then did the city-states send out the star war orders and the league marched. The march was a column: nobles with their spears and thrusting spears, infantry spread into a loose line with atlatls and bows. There was no phalanx and no wall of shields pressed shoulder to shoulder; at close quarters the work was done with short weapons and stone axes, man to man, taking prisoners. The measure of victory was often not annihilation but capture: seizing the enemy ruler and the heads of his noble houses, carrying them home for sacrifice or holding them for ransom, after which the loser answered the change of masters by re-erecting the sanctuary and recutting the monuments. Cities were usually taken by night or dawn, setting the temples alight, breaking the causeways and cutting the water and food routes; once inside, the victors smashed the defeated side's ceremonial monuments, the heart groups, the water groups and the sky columns, and raised their own. The one kind of order the campaign did have was rhythm: the same day, the same ritual, the same ancient road, carrying the expedition to the gates of the enemy. The dory's synchronisation, in which every man thrusts at the same instant, simply does not exist here; here the synchronisation comes from a table of days.
data: 可核對的數字不多，先列確定的：戰爭總表給本役的時間是公元六九五年起、至六九五年止，歷時一年；同一張表裏可見的瑪雅「星戰」條目還有五六二年（第一次）、六三一年、六三六年、六八〇年（第九次）、七〇五年（第十次）、七一一年（第十一次），六九五年正落在第九次與第十次之間。以通用對應換算，公元六九五年約當長紀年曆九點一三卡屯的末段，但這只是推算，碑銘原文的日期仍須以各碑釋文為準。距離方面，蒂卡爾到卡拉克穆爾直線約二百五十公里，爭奪地帶正落在佩滕南緣與坎佩切北緣之間，烏克斯維察與多斯皮拉斯兩個前哨之間是最可能的交鋒地；納蘭霍到蒂卡爾約二百五十公里，納蘭霍到卡拉科爾約二百公里。人口沒有普查，只能引用考古估算的量級：蒂卡爾鼎盛期約五萬至六萬人，卡拉克穆爾核心區約四萬至五萬人，卡拉科爾約一萬人上下，納蘭霍核心區只有一兩千人。戰爭列表本身沒有記月日，本卡把本役暫繫於乾季（四月），這是依星戰通常在收成後開打而作的推斷，不是文獻記載。
dataEn: There are not many verifiable figures, so start with the certain ones. The war list gives the campaign a start of AD 695 and an end of AD 695, that is, a single year; the same table holds the Maya star war entries for 562 (the first), 631, 636, 680 (the ninth), 705 (the tenth) and 711 (the eleventh), so 695 falls between the ninth and the tenth. Converted with the standard correlation, AD 695 falls towards the end of the 9.13 katun of the Long Count, but that is only a calculation, and the dates actually carved on the monuments must be taken from the published readings of each stela. As for distances, Tikal and Calakmul are about 250 kilometres apart in a straight line, and the contested ground lies on the southern rim of Peten and the northern edge of Campeche, with the stretch between the two outposts of Uaxactun and Dos Pilas the likeliest ground of collision; Naranjo is about 250 kilometres from Tikal and about 200 kilometres from Caracol. There is no census, and only the order of magnitude of archaeological estimates can be used: Tikal at its height held perhaps fifty to sixty thousand people, the core area of Calakmul some forty to fifty thousand, Caracol around ten thousand, and the core of Naranjo only one or two thousand. The war list itself records no month, and this card attaches the campaign provisionally to the dry season, in April; that is an inference drawn from the habit of opening star wars after the harvest, and not a documentary statement.
cause: 打起來有兩層。第一層是佩滕盆地的霸權之爭：卡拉克穆爾蛇王朝在六九○年代向蒂卡爾的南翼推壓，多斯皮拉斯自六二九年另立後成了它在佩滕東側的前哨，被壓迫的城邦紛紛改換盟主，六三六年那次星戰之後整個南翼的聯盟幾乎重排；蒂卡爾在豹葉治下既要頂住北面的卡拉克穆爾，又要收拾內部的附庸倒戈，於是把對方的每一次越界懲罰都視為必須回敬的行動。第二層是北線：納蘭霍的賈索·錢·卡維爾一世靠星戰把卡拉科爾壓回貝里斯山區，六九○年代正是他連續用兵的年份，而戰爭總表把「錢·卡維爾」這個共用的王名骨幹安在佩滕這條線上，才產生了本卡這種南北混線的題目。引戰還有第三個非戰因素：曆法。星戰要選日子，出征令要由城邦的祭司團體背書，聯盟的出兵比例、贖金條件與俘虜分配都在城郊議定。於是「開戰」在瑪雅世界常常是一場先於戰鬥的政治儀式——先把日期訂下來，戰爭才取得合法。
causeEn: There are two layers to the outbreak. The first is the struggle for hegemony in the Peten basin: the Snake dynasty of Calakmul was pressing against the southern flank of Tikal in the 690s, Dos Pilas, independent since 629, had become its outpost on the eastern side of Peten, and the oppressed city-states were switching masters in waves; after the star war of 636 the whole southern alliance had been rearranged. Tikal under Foliated Jaguar had both to hold off Calakmul from the north and to discipline the client states turning away inside its own orbit, so every punitive raid across the border had to be answered in kind. The second layer is the northern front: Jasaw Chan K'awiil I of Naranjo was using star wars to push Caracol back into the Belize mountains, the 690s being exactly the years of his repeated campaigning, and the war list placed the shared royal name element 'Chan K'awiil' on the Peten line, which is what produced a title such as this one, mixing the southern and northern fronts. A third cause is not a cause of war at all but a calendar: star wars required an appointed day, the orders to march required the endorsement of the city-states' priestly bodies, and the league's ratios of levies, terms of ransom and division of captives were all settled outside the towns. To 'go to war' in the Maya world was therefore often a political ritual performed before any fighting: date the day first, and only then does the war become legitimate.
impact: 這類戰役留下的地標不是版圖，而是碑。勝方在敗方城址上砸掉舊的儀式性紀念碑，重新立起自己的心組、水組與天象柱，把一次勝負寫成王朝的正當性；被擄的君主與世族首腦在勝方被獻祭，貴族家族的血脈就此斷絕，聯盟則要重新排列效忠對象。對整個佩滕來說，六九○年代是長期消耗的開始：城邦之間的爭鬥從「報復」變成「常態」，貴族們年年都要備戰、籌糧、走古道，儀式性的遠征成了政治生活的固定開支，祭司團的權力也隨着挑日子、定日子而上升。往後的走向並不站在任何一方：卡拉克穆爾在七三○年代中葉之後由盛轉衰，納蘭霍一系反倒坐大，佩滕的聯盟在七四○年代出現逆轉，連卡拉克穆爾自己也在七三六年之後從名單上的主動方變成被吞併的一方。可以確定的是，長期「星戰」把瑪雅城邦政治變成一部以俘獲為資源的循環：每一次勝利都換來一批可供展示的俘虜，也換來下一次不得不回應的挑戰。
impactEn: The landmark such a campaign leaves behind is not a frontier but a stone. The victors smashed the old ceremonial monuments on the defeated city's site and raised their own heart groups, water groups and sky columns, writing a single victory into the legitimacy of a dynasty; the captured ruler and the heads of the captured noble houses were sacrificed in the winning city, aristocratic lines were broken off at the root, and the league had to be rearranged all over again in terms of who owed allegiance to whom. For Peten as a whole the 690s mark the beginning of a long attrition: war between the city-states changed from revenge into routine, nobles had to levy, to provision and to walk the ancient road every single year, the ritual expedition became a fixed item in political life, and the authority of the priestly bodies rose along with the power of choosing and fixing the day. What followed favoured no side: Calakmul declined after the middle of the 730s, the Naranjo line grew instead, the alliances of Peten reversed in the 740s, and Calakmul itself, after 736, turned from the party that appears in the list as the aggressor into the one that is swallowed. What can be certain is that the long run of star wars turned Maya city-state politics into a cycle powered by captives: every victory brought a set of captives to display, and with it the next challenge that had to be answered.
result: 結果這一欄，戰爭總表只給了起訖同為公元六九五年，沒有勝負、沒有雙方損失數字，這是這條記錄的真實狀態，不必替它補。碑銘傳統可以確定的是另一件事：六九○年代末確有一場以擒獲為目的的懲罰性遠征，北方城邦的君主或世族首腦被帶走，並在勝方被獻祭；敗方付出的代價是「聖所被毀、紀念碑被改刻」，盟邦網絡重新洗牌。瑪雅城邦的標準處置從來不是屠城，而是改立碑銘、要求贖金、用儀式重啟被破壞的聖所，再以國名與王號的更替宣示易主；所以本役的結局應寫成「記錄殘缺、勝負存疑」：勝負沒有留下文字，輸贏的痕跡卻留在雙方的碑石與城址上。對讀者而言，這一役的價值不在勝負，而在它示範了瑪雅城邦怎樣用一支遠征軍、一張曆表與一整套儀式，去管理一段無法完全控制的鄰國關係。
resultEn: For the result, the war list gives only a start and an end of AD 695, with no victor and no loss figures for either side; that is the true state of this record and there is no need to supply what is missing. The epigraphic tradition does allow something else to be stated: in the late 690s there was indeed a punitive expedition whose purpose was capture, the ruler or the heads of the noble houses of the northern city were carried off and sacrificed in the victorious city, and the defeated side paid in the destruction of its sanctuary and the recutting of its monuments, with the network of allies shuffled again. The standard handling of such a defeat in the Maya world was never a sack of the city, but the re-cutting of monuments, a demand for ransom, the ritual reopening of the shattered sanctuary, and a declaration of changed masters through the change of the city's name and the ruler's name; the outcome of this campaign should therefore be written as 'the record is fragmentary and the victor uncertain'. The result left no words, but the marks of winning and losing remain in the stones and the city sites on both sides. For the reader the value of this campaign lies not in the result but in the demonstration of how a Maya city-state managed a relationship with a neighbour it could not fully control, with one expeditionary column, one table of days, and a whole apparatus of ritual.
